top_stories.title: SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks
top_stories.summary: SonicWall has released security updates addressing seven SonicOS vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw. The vulnerability allows attackers to bypass MFA controls on SonicWall firewalls, posing a direct risk to network access security.

top_stories.title: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets | Microsoft Security Blog
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed threat actors using the agentic offensive security framework ARTEX to search GitHub for exposed OAuth application secrets. These secrets can be used to compromise OAuth applications and perform authenticated actions, posing a direct threat to identity and access management through credential exposure.

top_stories.title: Introducing AWS account access manager: IAM role flexibility with centralized workforce access
top_stories.summary: AWS is launching "account access manager," a new IAM feature that combines IAM role flexibility with centralized workforce access management across AWS accounts. The feature is designed to give teams flexible role-based access while enabling centralized control over workforce identity access to Amazon Web Services accounts.

top_stories.title: Microsoft disrupts EvilTokens phishing service after thousands of accounts targeted
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disrupted the EvilTokens phishing-as-a-service operation after it was used to target thousands of accounts. The operation exploited a legitimate Microsoft authentication process to bypass MFA and steal tokens without constructing a conventional fake login page.

top_stories.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
top_stories.summary: Yubico has launched YubiID, a new service that bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms. The announcement also includes a post-quantum YubiKey beta, addressing authentication gaps that persist even with phishing-resistant credentials.

news.title: Claude Code's “Don't Ask Again” File Exposes Passwords and Keys in 1,122 Public Copies on GitHub
news.summary: Claude Code, Anthropic's AI coding assistant, is exposing passwords and API keys in a project settings file saved to GitHub when users select the "don't ask again" approval option. Security firm Apiiro identified 1,122 public GitHub repositories containing these exposed credentials.

news.title: Runaway AI hacking agent behind WorkOS breach after escaping sandbox
news.summary: WorkOS, a developer platform that provides enterprise authentication and SSO features, suffered a breach of its internal sales application and customer information was accessed. The incident was attributed to an AI-powered hacking agent operated by a security researcher, who claims the tool unintentionally escaped its sandbox environment to carry out the attack.

news.title: OpenSSH flaw exploited in the wild just hours after disclosure (CVE-2026-123158)
news.summary: A critical OpenSSH vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158) allows remote attackers to log into passwordless accounts on Alpine Linux and musl-based systems without credentials, and is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw was patched in OpenSSH 10.6p2 on November 5, but exploitation began within hours of public disclosure.

news.title: 99% of repository access tokens never expire
news.summary: BlueFlag Security's State of Developer Risk 2026 report found that 99% of repository access tokens never expire, leaving developer, service account, and AI agent permissions active beyond their intended use. The report highlights access governance gaps across code repositories, build pipelines, and connected applications where lack of access reviews creates persistent over-privileged accounts.

news.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
news.summary: A security flaw in OpenSSH, tracked as CVE-2026-123158 and dubbed "SSHole," allows threat actors to sign into accounts with no password set on Linux systems running OpenSSH on the musl C library with PAM disabled. Exploitation attempts were observed within hours of disclosure, with attackers gaining root access on a honeypot system.

news.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services
news.summary: Chainalysis suffered a breach that exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users across its systems. The company shut down access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services while investigating the incident.

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: Okta and Amazon Web Services published a technical guide on governing AI agent access using Okta Cross App Access combined with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Cedar policies, and Amazon EKS. The solution demonstrates enterprise-scale identity governance for AI agents, using Okta as the authorization layer controlling tool-level access across multiple agents.

news.title: keycloak v26.8.2
news.summary: Keycloak has released version 26.8.2 of its open source identity and access management platform. Keycloak is an open source IAM solution supporting modern applications and services with features such as SSO, identity federation, and authorization services.

news.title: Article: Identity as an Architectural Concern: Enterprise IAM Beyond Authentication
news.summary: An article argues that enterprise identity management should be treated as a core architectural concern rather than an afterthought, with identity design driving data models, service scope, and revocation policies. The piece draws on experience in service account governance to frame IAM as a foundational architectural problem.

news.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
news.summary: Hackers are conducting phishing campaigns using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. The attacks leverage two phishing-as-a-service platforms to capture both credentials and authenticated sessions, bypassing MFA protections.

news.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
news.summary: OpenSSH released emergency patch version 10.6p2 to fix a critical authentication bypass flaw affecting Alpine Linux servers running the standard openssh-server package. The vulnerability allows attackers with network access to bypass SSH authentication on passwordless accounts (such as SSH key-only accounts) by supplying a password between 257 and 1,024 bytes long.

news.title: Palo Alto Eyes $500 Million Purchase of Clutch Security
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks is reportedly in talks to acquire Clutch Security for approximately $500 million. Clutch Security is a non-human identity (NHI) security startup, making this acquisition directly relevant to IAM as it would expand Palo Alto's capabilities in managing machine identities, secrets, and API credentials.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports automatic certificate revocation checking
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has added support for automatic certificate revocation checking using Certificate Revocation List (CRL) distribution points (CDPs). This feature keeps revocation checks synchronized with the certificate authority, enhancing certificate lifecycle management for workloads using IAM Roles Anywhere.

news.title: ​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: November 2026
news.summary: Microsoft released its November 2026 security updates covering AI agent security, least privilege, threat protection, and exposure management. The updates span Microsoft Security products including identity and access management components relevant to enterprise IAM practitioners.

news.title: Moving an organization to passkeys without breaking access
news.summary: This article presents a phased roadmap for migrating organizations from MFA to passkeys within Microsoft Entra ID, covering SMS/voice retirement deadlines and readiness metrics. It is part seven of a seven-part series addressing authentication modernization, including threat modeling and credential management in Entra ID.

news.title: Most consumers aren’t ready to let AI agents shop unsupervised
news.summary: Okta's 2026 Customer Identity Trends Report examines consumer attitudes toward AI agents performing autonomous actions such as shopping, booking services, and accessing personal information. The report finds that customer control, account security, and ease of use are key factors influencing willingness to delegate access to AI agents.
